name: J. Doe
bio: International correspondent based in Nairobi, focusing on African political economy, anti-imperialist struggle, and the legacy of colonialism across the continent.

name: M. Garcia
bio: Editor covering Latin America with an emphasis on socialism, popular movements, and resistance to U.S. imperialism. Former organizer in international solidarity campaigns.

name: Editorial Board
bio: Collective editorial leadership providing political direction and oversight, grounded in Marxist-Leninist analysis and a commitment to working-class journalism.

name: Comrade Saint
bio: Member of the collective editorial leadership, contributing strategic vision, ideological clarity, and editorial guidance rooted in Marxist-Leninist principles.
